Language Movement
2014-02-16T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/language-movement-11484

To observe the Language Movement and the spirit of Ekushe February, literary organisation Gantha held a discussion recently at the EMK centre at Dhanmondi, Dhaka, says a press release. Dr. Niaz Zaman, faculty member of the Department of English, University of Dhaka and the founder of the group, Gantha moderated the discussion. Bhasha Shoinik Ayesha Akhter, poet Kazi Rosy, Jowshan Ara Rahman and Rita Bhoumick read Bangla poems and extracts from their own writings. Gantha members paid tributes to the martyrs of the Language Movement. Discussants read out literary pieces and poems which highlighted the role of women during the Language Movement in 1952. They pointed out that women played a dynamic role in the movement and small groups of women led the march past during the first procession of the time. Women stood at the frontlines to avoid arrest. Through all the odds they assumed a patriotic leadership role. Gantha seeks to create a bridge between Bangla and English literature. Its prime task is to introduce English and other world literature in French, German and Russian to Bangla speaking readers. It also discusses and translates quality Bangla literature into English, adds the press release.
